services.desc: Most beautiful and unique balloon flight in the Country! Duration Flight time of approximately 1 hour, allow 5 hours for the whole experience, from the time we meet until the time we're done. See our [What to Expect](https://www.riograndeballoons.com/what-to-expect) page for for information. About Our sunrise hot air balloon flights take us over the beautiful landscape of the Rio Grande del Norte National monument. The Sangre de Christo mountains provide a backdrop to the dramatic Rio Grande Gorge cutting through the expansive, Sage-covered Taos Plateau.
